resources.string: Make your own stickers for WhatsApp and Telegram
Make stickers from your photos or import a pack you already have.

Fetch or network error. Check your connection and Bot Token, then retry.

All Telegram tasks share these threads for fetching, downloading and converting. Default: 2; maximum: 6. Changes adjust concurrency while current steps finish. Animated conversions also respect available memory.
